name: scryboard-agent-runner
description: Desktop app that runs Node-CLI Scryboard apps without a terminal. This is a proof-of-concept build: proves the click-a-link-to-download-and-run loop works, before the real tray app, auto-updates, code signing, or multi-app management get built on top of it. 0.2.1 adds the importCanon/canonImportStatus client methods (the Scryboard canon_import capability -- Kanka Codex 1.2.0 imports the DM's Kanka wiki into the World Bible through it) and re-linking: opening an install link for an app that is already installed for the same campaign swaps in the new token and updates in place, keeping the app's secrets and state -- what the website's "Update and re-issue token" flow hands you when a new version needs different access.
